recipes.name: Shrimp in Avocado Cream Sauce
ingredients_raw: 0.5 pound large shrimp, peeled and deveined

steps.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat, stir in the garlic, and cook 1 to 2 minutes until soft but not browned. Pour in the cream and bring to a simmer. Whisk in the avocado until smooth, return to a simmer, and add the shrimp.
Cook over medium-low heat just until the shrimp have turned opaque, 5 to 7 minutes. Sprinkle with black pepper, and serve hot.

raw_recipe.headline: Shrimp in Avocado Cream Sauce
raw_recipe.description: Tender, pink shrimp are cooked in a pale green, creamy sauce thickened with ripe avocado.

review.reviewBody: A new favorite! I used butter and olive oil, sauteed 3 green onions and garlic for a few mins. added about 3/4c. of half n half, some seasoned salt, like nature's seasoning, and then mashed up 3 whole avacados into this mixture and reduced it a bit. What resulted was a thick, creamy, (but with good texture) sauce that I poured over toasted sourdough bread with shrimp on top,(they were already cooked)grilled asparagus and a salad of mixed greens with pears, dried cranberries and poppy seed dressing. A big hit. Take a recipe and make it your own. Use it as a guideline and suit it to you and your family's taste. This idea was exceptional and I will be making this again and again for my family.

excellent! i blended cream, avocado and creole seasoning in the blender to make it as smooth as possible.
always, when i use shrimp, i marinate it in creole seasoning for at least a half hour. very tasty, indeed.

I just made this tonight. I sauteed a little bit of vidalia onion and a lot of garlic in a stick of butter. added about 2 cups milk and 2 avacodos. Added salt and pepper. I cooked the shrimp separate in olive oil and added redfish seasoning. Served over spaghetti noodles. Smells great and taste great! Thanks for the base recipe!!
I made this sauce with bell peppers and baby Bella mushrooms. It was amazing and delicious

I added tender sauteed steak, crawdads, and crabmeat along with shrimp. Also used lime juice, tajin chili lime seasoning, cayenne pepper, and Old Bay. I made a big pot and my teenaged son ate most of it. Wow!
My only critique: less butter, more seasoning. I added 2 tsp of lemon pepper to decrease the overwhelming butter flavor.

I typed in the words "avocado shrimp cream," this recipe came up. I fried shrimp and added frozen vegetables. Added 1/2 cup white cheese to the sauce when it was finished cooking. It needed a tiny bit more pizazz, so I added a TBL of lemon juice! Perfect! I put the shrimp and veggies over prepared brown rice and covered with the avocado sauce! Husband loved it! Thanks!

I sauteed onions & garlic in the butter before adding avacado, and added some spices (salt, garlic powder) and cheese (pecorino romano) at the very end. Otherwise, this dish would have been very bland. I served it over rice, and it was very filling.
I made this sauce and it was delicious...made it withzzucchini spaghetti n shrimp...what a great meal....
Turned out decent, but I had higher hopes. Actually a 3.5 star rating. Used extra garlic and avocado. Then right before I pulled it off the stove, I added cilantro, green onion, and lime juice.

HOLY GUACAMOLE WAS THIS GOOD! I made few changes: almond milk instead of cream, extra garlic, LOTS of grated parmesan on top, and served it over ditalini. Wow. I was worried it wouldn't turn out very good because my avocado was a bit on the chunky side, but it was way better than I expected. Thank you for the recipe!

Not bad. Full marks for speed of preparation, but a little bit bland. I added a healthy pinch of salt, which helped, but it needed something else. I'll toy with this as a base recipe though, it's got potential.
Delicious and easy. I don't usually have heavy cream so I normally use skim milk.
Tried it with a dab of pesto/basil olive oil mixed in, and it wasn't bad.
I thought it was very delicious. Tonight I will try to use the idea with salmon. I think it will work

The sauce is very mild, almost bland, but it doesn’t mask the taste of the shrimp. I would add a little lime juice next time – but I still loved it. It would be easy to add some jazz to this dish to suit your tastes.
Super easy to make and the whole family loved it. I served over fettucini noodles with hot veggies and dinner rolls on the side and some.

Yumm-o!! I used Light Cream instead of Heavy, added more shrimp (cuz there was a ton of sauce) and Old Bay seasoning, (and some crushed red peppers for myself). It was fabulous. My kids loved it too, even tho it was green! Definitely a keeper!

Pretty good recipe I will say. I tried this recipe last night and it was pretty good (my roommate even liked it). I brought leftovers to work today and with all you put in it the avacado didn't brown overnight (this I liked) It did start a little bland and could definately be spiced up or down to suit your personal taste. I did add a packet of dry Hidden Valley Ranch to it (attempting to get a avacado ranch taste)... it was OK.
Delicious - I added sauteed onions & zucchini to make it a little more than just sauce.
